question: Read `transcript_excerpt`, the extracted memory `item`, and the supporting `quote`. Decide which kind of source the item rests on. Choose exactly one option; the option descriptions define what each option means.

rubrics.text: The user said it directly in the transcript excerpt, in their own words, as a fact, preference, decision or instruction about themselves or their work.
The content comes from a tool or system output shown in the transcript excerpt (a command result, file content, search result, API response), not from something the user said.
Neither the user nor a tool stated it; the item is a conclusion drawn from behaviour, patterns or indirect evidence in the transcript excerpt.
The content was brought into the conversation from an external document, prior memory or pasted material that the transcript excerpt quotes or references rather than originates.

binding_note: bindings[name] = rubric index bound to name slot j, i.e. name j is bound to rubric (j + s) mod 4; with aligned this is a Latin square.
